payload.question: What was the exact measured p99 latency in milliseconds when ReAct was deployed at Hangzhou Airport in August 2026?

claims.claim: The DPR reader can fit up to 100 passages per question into one batch on a single 32GB GPU, keeping latency almost identical to the single passage case at around 20ms.
claims.quote: While DPR processes up to 100 passages for each question, the reader is able to ﬁt all of them into one batch on a single 32GB GPU, thus the latency remains almost identical to the single passage case (around 20ms).
claims.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering

claims.claim: The paper notes it is not completely clear how much more inference time the reader takes compared to ORQA despite considering more passages.
claims.quote: One thing worth noticing is that our reader does consider more passages compared to ORQA, although it is not completely clear how much more time it takes for inference.
claims.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
